zh: 对任意一行 i 和一列 j，都有“列 j 的最小值 ≤ a[i][j] ≤ 行 i 的最大值”，所以所有列最小值都不超过所有行最大值。
只需要两个量：所有行最大值中的最小值 R，和所有列最小值中的最大值 C；合法元素存在当且仅当 R=C，而且这时它的值就是 R。
逐行读入，每行求出最大值并更新 R=min(R, 行最大值)，同时用长度为 M 的数组维护每列最小值；读完后 C=max(列最小值)；若 C==R 输出该值，否则输出 −1。不必保存整个矩阵。
en: For any row i and column j, the minimum of column j <= a[i][j] <= the maximum of row i, so every column minimum is at most every row maximum.
Only two numbers matter: R, the smallest of the row maxima, and C, the largest of the column minima; a valid element exists exactly when R = C, and then its value is R.

Read row by row, take each row maximum and update R = min(R, row maximum), while an array of length M keeps every column minimum; at the end C = max(column minima); print the value if C == R, otherwise -1. The whole matrix never needs to be stored.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Process the matrix row by row, recording the minimum of each column and R, the minimum of all row maxima. Let C be the maximum of the column minima; if R=C output that value, otherwise -1. Only M column values are kept; no copy of a million-integer matrix is built.

## Proof of correctness

For any row i and column j, the minimum of column j <= a[i][j] <= the maximum of row i, hence C<=R. If R=C, take a row attaining R and a column attaining C; their intersection is squeezed between the same value on both sides, so it is exactly a valid element. Conversely, if some intersection is both a row maximum and a column minimum, then C>=that value and R<=that value, which together with C<=R makes all three equal; every valid intersection has the same value, so no rule for choosing among several positions needs to be invented.

## Complexity

O(NM) time and O(M) auxiliary space, not counting the input text; parsing row by row avoids keeping a million number objects.
